sm.comment: Switch track. Height minus thumb is 8px: 4px on each side, 2px of edge and 2px of air.

md.comment: Switch track. Height minus thumb is 8px: 4px on each side, 2px of edge and 2px of air.

sm.comment: Switch track. Wide enough that the thumb sits clearly to the left or to the right.

md.comment: Switch track. Wide enough that the thumb sits clearly to the left or to the right.

lg.comment: Switch track. Wide enough that the thumb sits clearly to the left or to the right.

sm.comment: The knob of a switch. 8px smaller than its track height, so it sits 4px inside the edge.

md.comment: The knob of a switch. 8px smaller than its track height, so it sits 4px inside the edge.

lg.comment: The knob of a switch. 8px smaller than its track height, so it sits 4px inside the edge.

sm.comment: Height of static labels such as badges. They are not clickable, so they may sit below the 24px target size.

md.comment: Height of static labels such as badges. They are not clickable, so they may sit below the 24px target size.

min.comment: The smallest pointer target WCAG 2.5.8 allows. Nothing clickable is smaller.

comfortable.comment: The target for touch-first controls and primary actions on small screens.

prose.comment: Maximum width of running text: about 70 to 80 characters of body copy per line.
